wall_box = solid.box@1(size=[5, 2.6, 4])
tris = poly.from_solid@1(wall_box)
flat = poly.merge_coplanar@1(tris)
edges = poly.select@1(flat, element="edge", by="sharp", angle=0.5235987755982988rad)
soft = poly.bevel_network@1(flat, edges, width=0.04)
shell = poly.to_solid@1(soft)
cutter = solid.box@1(size=[0.9, 2, 0.2])
cutter_at = xform.move@1(cutter, by=[0, -0.3, 2])
walls_cut = solid.difference@1(shell, cutter_at)
walls_col = solid.material@1(walls_cut, color=[0.87, 0.78, 0.6], roughness=0.8)
walls = xform.move@1(walls_col, by=[0, 1.3, 0])
slab = solid.box@1(size=[5.6, 0.1, 4.6])
slab_t = poly.from_solid@1(slab)
slab_f = poly.merge_coplanar@1(slab_t)
slab_top = poly.select@1(slab_f, by="normal", angle=0.08726646259971647rad)
peak = poly.poke@1(slab_f, slab_top, offset=1.5)
roof_solid = poly.to_solid@1(peak)
roof_col = solid.material@1(roof_solid, color=[0.5, 0.1, 0.08], roughness=0.6)
roof = xform.move@1(roof_col, by=[0, 2.65, 0])
output walls
output roof
